info.description: Meldingstjener Rest API. Default API version.

get.summary: Get an array of notifications from a specific offset

parameters.name: HerIds
parameters.description: HER-ids (one or more) to fetch notifications for. Max 1500 HER-ids can be provided in one request.

parameters.name: NotificationsToFetch
parameters.description: How many notifications to fetch (default = 100) (If set, must be a number between 1 and 1000).

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Offset of the last notification received from this endpoint, ensures only newer notifications is returned

parameters.name: nhn-source-system
parameters.description: Name and version for the client system

description.description: Description of error code following standards.

oid.description: OID of the code standard providing the error code.

AppRecError.description: Information about an error in the application receipt.

AppRecStatus.description:
Application receipt status. Values taken from HIS 80415 / OID=8258.

- Ok = "Ok"

- Rejected = "Avvist"

- OkErrorInMessagePart = "Ok, feil i delmelding" NB! Not supported as of this writing.

transportSenderHerId.description: If set, the sender addressation is overridden. Else, the sender addressation will mirror the received business document.

transportReceiverHerId.description: If set, the receiver addressation is overridden. Else, the receiver addressation will mirror the received business document.

cpaId.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1037:2011 will be generated.

conversationId.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1037:2011 will be generated.

service.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1209:2018 will be generated.

serviceType.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1209:2018 will be generated.

action.description: If not set, value will be resolved from BusinessDocument.

senderRole.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1209:2018 will be generated.

receiverRole.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1209:2018 will be generated.

middlewareName.description: Some systems use a middleware between application and messagehandler. Name can be provided here. (HIS 1210:2018)

middlewareVersion.description: Some systems use a middleware between application and messagehandler. Version can be provided here. (HIS 1210:2018)

compressPayload.description:
Some systems expect the businessdocument to be compressed before encrypted and added to Ebxml.
When set to 'true' the payload will be compressed using the Gzip algorithm

AppRecTransportMetadataOverrides.description:
Information to be used for the EbXml generation for AppRec messages - overrides properties otherwise set automatically according to standards.

Only needs to be used if you require an exchange that exceeds (is in violation of) the standards.

appRecStatus.description: Application receipt status. Values taken from HIS 80415 / OID=8258.

appRecErrorList.description: List with errors in the application receipt, if any

appRecId.description: The id of the received application receipt, if it exists.

notificationIds.description: Notification IDs to delete. Cannot contain more than 1000 Notifications.

DeliveryState.description:
Value 'Unconfirmed': Transport is not confirmed.
Value 'Acknowledged': Transport is confirmed. Equivalent to 'Acknowledgement' without severe 'eb:ErrorList/eb:HighestSeverity'.
Value 'Rejected': Transport is rejected. Equivalient to 'MessageError' with 'eb:ErrorList/eb:HighestSeverity'="Error".
Value 'Abandoned': Message has been sent and then resent to EDI-receiver, but no transport receipt has been received.

businessDocument.description:
The business document - Payload.

The BusinessDocument is the raw bytes of the payload encoded with ContentTransferEncoding

contentType.description:
Content type for the business document.

Most payloads should be xml

contentTransferEncoding.description:
Content transfer encoding for the business document.

Payload is always base64-encoded.

GetBusinessDocumentResponse.description: Business document (payload) and metadata returned from GET/business-document on Messages

id.description:
Internal id of message. To be used when using messages/{id}/*-endpoints.

Will always be a valid Guid

contentType.description: Content type for the business document

receiverHerId.description: The HER-id of the receiver/copy receiver of the business document

cpaId.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1037:2011 will be generated.

conversationId.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1037:2011 will be generated.

service.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1209:2018 will be generated.

serviceType.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1209:2018 will be generated.

action.description: If not set, value will be resolved from BusinessDocument.

senderRole.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1209:2018 will be generated.

receiverRole.description: If not set, value according to HIS 1209:2018 will be generated.

middlewareName.description: Some systems use a middleware between application and messagehandler. Name can be provided here. (HIS 1210:2018)

middlewareVersion.description: Some systems use a middleware between application and messagehandler. Version can be provided here. (HIS 1210:2018)

compressPayload.description:
Some systems expect the businessdocument to be compressed before encrypted and added to Ebxml.
When set to 'true' the payload will be compressed using the Gzip algorithm

MessageTransportMetadataOverrides.description:
Information to be used for EbXml generation - overrides properties otherwise set automatically according to standards.

Only needs to be used if you require an exchange that exceeds (is in violation of) the standards.

herId.description: The HerId this configuration applies to.

clientLocked.description: Indicates that the requesting client is the sole consumer and producer of messages for this HerId. Others will be forbidden.

rejectMessageFilters.description:
Indicates which indicators that result in messages being rejected by the MSH. If null, then no messages are rejected.

- MessageFunction = 1 - Correspond to values from "Helsedirektoratet kodeverk 8279 - Meldingens funksjon".

relatedMessageId.description: The id of the message related to this notification.

notificationTriggeredByHerId.description: Which communication party's action triggered this notification.

createdAt.description: Datetime offset when the notification was created.

appRecSenderHerId.description: The HerID of the sender to be used in generating the AppRec (receiver of original message). Used for business document and addressation.

appRecStatus.description:
The status of the application receipt sent for a received message

1 = Ok, 2 = Avvist, 3 = Ok, feil i delmelding

appRecErrorList.description: List of errors in application receipt

transportMetadataOverrides.description:
One or more EbXml-properties can be provided if business process has special requirements.

For most business processes the values can and will be resolved from the required request metadata
by the server, and therefore does not have to be applied twice.
Current implementation is following 'HIS 1037:2011' and 'HIS 1209:2018'

businessDocument.description: The business document - Payload as an encoded byte array.

senderHerId.description: The HerID of the sender to be used in the adressation (envelope).

receiverHerIds.description: The HerIDs of the receivers to be used in the adressation (envelope).

contentType.description: Content type for the business document bytes. Currently, only 'application/xml' is supported.

contentTransferEncoding.description: Content transfer encoding for the business document. Currently, only 'base64' is supported.

messageTypeIdentificator.description: Identifies the type of business document being sent. Should be from FinnKode 8279.

transportMetadataOverrides.description:
One or more EbXml-properties can be provided if business process has special requirements.

For most business processes the values can and will be resolved from the required request metadata
by the server, and therefore does not have to be applied twice.
Current implementation is following 'HIS 1037:2011' and 'HIS 1209:2018'

PostMessageRequest.description: Business document (payload) and metadata for POST on Messages

ReceiveNotificationChannel.description:
Receive channel for messages

- Api = 1
- Kafka = 3 - ONLY VIABLE FOR NHN INTERNAL ACTORS

configurations.description: Collection of MSH configurations to apply.

SetMshConfigurationsRequest.description: Represents the request body for creating or updating one or more MSH configurations.

receiverHerId.description: The HER-id of the receiver/copy receiver of the business document

transportDeliveryState.description: Transport delivery state for the message. Refers to whether the transport is successful, not whether the message was accepted by the receiver system.

apprecInfo.description:
Apprec with status and potential errors from the application receipt
Value is 'null' if an Apprec has not been received from the receiver.'

StatusInfo.description: Status information about the message exchange

relatedMessageId.description: The id of the message related to this notification.

notificationTriggeredByHerId.description: Which communication party's action triggered this notification.

createdAt.description: Datetime offset when the notification was created.
